name: baoyu-youtube-transcript
tagline_zh: 丢个YouTube链接，字幕、封面秒到手。支持多语言、翻译、章节、说话人识别，还带缓存，重复处理不卡壳。
tagline_en: Drop a YouTube link, get subtitles & cover instantly. Multi-language, translation, chapters, speaker ID, with.
desc_en: Downloads YouTube video transcripts/subtitles and cover images by URL or video ID. Supports multiple languages, translation, chapters, and speaker identification. Caches raw data for fast re-formatting. Use when user asks to "get YouTube transcript", "download subtitles", "get captions", "YouTube字幕", "YouTube封面", "视频封面", "video thumbnail", "video cover image", or provides a YouTube URL and wants t
why_zh: 同类工具只抓文本，它连封面、章节、说话人一并打包，且缓存原始数据，二次格式化飞快。
why_en: Unlike tools that only grab text, it bundles cover, chapters, and speaker ID, caching raw data for instant re-formatting.
